title: Tune Muon matrix LR (MATRIX_LR sweep)
description: Increased MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.05 (25% higher Muon LR), all else unchanged at DEPTH=10 baseline.
reflection: Regressed val_bpb to 1.005762 vs baseline 1.002279, so the current MATRIX_LR=0.04 was already better tuned than a 25% bump. This suggests the Muon LR is near a local optimum in the increasing direction; a follow-up should try lower values (e.g. 0.03) rather than higher ones, though given only one data point this round, someone should also consider whether other untouched hyperparameters (e.g. WARMUP_RATIO, WINDOW_PATTERN, WEIGHT_DECAY) are more promising than continuing a fine MATRIX_LR grid.
